'''Minimal is maximal''' was a phrase used by dress makers. It was best to persuade dissident people to at least try a dress.

[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] heard that phrase two times when trying on dresses for [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|her wedding]]. This is what compelled her to run off into the streets.
